title: Settings preview is orientation status
summary: Reclassified the Settings Decision Preview panel as a status/orientation panel instead of an evidence panel, renamed the visible scope row from Evidence scope to Preview scope, and refreshed matching tests, DOM inventory, and generated summaries.
reason: The panel presents saved-settings orientation only. Marking it as evidence made the UI imply stronger proof authority than the panel actually has.
behavior_before: The Settings Decision Preview panel used data-panel-type="evidence", showed the automatic evidence badge, and labeled the saved-settings boundary row Evidence scope.
behavior_after: The Settings Decision Preview panel uses data-panel-type="status", no longer gets the evidence badge or evidence-toggle behavior, and labels the saved-settings boundary row Preview scope.
